WITH rental_store_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.rental_id,
    i.store_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS rental_payment_total,
    COUNT(*) AS payment_count
  FROM payment AS p
  JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  WHERE p.amount >= 4.99
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
)
SELECT
  store_id,
  AVG(rental_payment_total) AS avg_payment_total_per_rental,
  AVG(payment_count) AS avg_payments_per_rental
FROM rental_store_totals
GROUP BY store_id;
